1|/**
2| * @struct
3| *
4| * The payload of PRIORITY_UPDATE frame.  PRIORITY_UPDATE frame is a
5| * non-critical extension to HTTP/2.  If this frame is received, and
6| * `nghttp2_option_set_user_recv_extension_type()` is not set, and
7| * `nghttp2_option_set_builtin_recv_extension_type()` is set for
8| * :enum:`nghttp2_frame_type.NGHTTP2_PRIORITY_UPDATE`,
9| * ``nghttp2_extension.payload`` will point to this struct.
10| *
11| * It has the following members:
12| */
13|typedef struct {
14|  /**
15|   * The stream ID of the stream whose priority is updated.
16|   */
17|  int32_t stream_id;
18|  /**
19|   * The pointer to Priority field value.  It is not necessarily
20|   * NULL-terminated.
21|   */
22|  uint8_t *field_value;
23|  /**
24|   * The length of the :member:`field_value`.
25|   */
26|  size_t field_value_len;
27|} nghttp2_ext_priority_update;

29|/**
30| * @function
31| *
32| * Submits PRIORITY_UPDATE frame.
33| *
34| * PRIORITY_UPDATE frame is a non-critical extension to HTTP/2, and
35| * defined in :rfc:`9218#section-7.1`.
36| *
37| * The |flags| is currently ignored and should be
38| * :enum:`nghttp2_flag.NGHTTP2_FLAG_NONE`.
39| *
40| * The |stream_id| is the ID of stream which is prioritized.  The
41| * |field_value| points to the Priority field value.  The
42| * |field_value_len| is the length of the Priority field value.
43| *
44| * If this function is called by server,
45| * :enum:`nghttp2_error.NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE` is returned.
46| *
47| * If
48| * :enum:`nghttp2_settings_id.NGHTTP2_SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES`
49| * of value of 0 is received by a remote endpoint (or it is omitted),
50| * this function does nothing and returns 0.
51| *
52| * This function returns 0 if it succeeds, or one of the following
53| * negative error codes:
54| *
55| * :enum:`nghttp2_error.NGHTTP2_ERR_NOMEM`
56| *     Out of memory
57| * :enum:`nghttp2_error.NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE`
58| *     The function is called from server side session
59| * :enum:`nghttp2_error.NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT`
60| *     The |field_value_len| is larger than 16380; or |stream_id| is
61| *     0.
62| */
63|NGHTTP2_EXTERN int nghttp2_submit_priority_update(nghttp2_session *session,
64|                                                  uint8_t flags,
65|                                                  int32_t stream_id,
66|                                                  const uint8_t *field_value,
67|                                                  size_t field_value_len);
